'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone warfare|drone strike]] on [[Kharkiv]] kills eight [[civilian]]s and injures ten others. At least nine [[tower block|high-rise buildings]] and a [[filling station|petrol station]] are badly damaged. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/4/6/at-least-six-killed-in-russian-strikes-on-ukraines-kharkiv (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-dead-new-russian-strike-kharkiv-injures-seven-regional-governor-2024-04-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Eight children are killed and two more injured by a [[roadside bomb]] in [[Daraa Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-explosion-daraa-children-golan-heights-jordan-23467bb093e910e30540007164b4e583 (AP)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]], [[Karen conflict]]
**The [[Karen National Union]] captures the town of [[Myawaddy]] in [[Kayin State]] as hundreds of [[Tatmadaw|junta troops]] surrender and hand over their weapons to rebel forces. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-68750528 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Central Asian floods]]
**[[Orsk Dam collapse]]
***Around 2,500 houses are flooded and at least four people are killed after the Orsk dam in [[Orenburg]], [[Russia]], bursts due to maintenance errors following heavy rainfall. Around 47,000 people in Russia and [[Kazakhstan]] are evacuated. Kazakh President [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]] calls it one of the "worst natural disasters in the past 80 years". [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/ap-kazakhstan-caspian-sea-b2524424.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.hln.be/buitenland/dam-barst-in-russische-oeral-2-500-huizen-overstroomd-maar-ergste-moet-nog-komen~a6556890/ (Het Laatse Nieuws)] [https://tass.com/emergencies/1771469/amp (Tass)]

**[[Nicaragua]] suspends diplomatic relations with [[Ecuador]] following the raid on the [[Mexico|Mexican]] embassy in [[Quito]], Ecuador. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/2024/04/06/nicaragua-cuts-ties-with-ecuador-after-raid-on-mexican-embassy (Al Arabiya)]
